Create meteo input file for 3DCMCCFEM model from E-OBS

Source: R/make_meteo_EOBS.R
make_meteo_EOBS.Rd

make_meteo_EOBS uses the E-OBS database to create the meteo input file according to the 3DCMCCFEM model specifications. The time period covered is 1950-01-01 - 2024-06-30 for the version 30.0 and 1950-01-01 - 2023-12-31 for the version 29.0.

Usage

make_meteo_EOBS(
  plot,
  crs = NULL,
  buffer = 100,
  id = NULL,
  daterange = NULL,
  convert_rad = TRUE,
  parallel = FALSE,
  site = NULL,
  outdir = NULL,
  return_df = FALSE,
  version = c("30.0", "29.0"),
  eobs_dir = getOption("R3DFEM.eobs_dir", system.file("extdata", package = "R3DFEM"))
)

Arguments

plot

Sf object or something that can be converted to an sf point object (i.e., a data.frame of coordinates). If plot is a data.frame the argument crs must be specified.

crs

Numeric: a valid EPSG code

buffer

Numeric: buffer around plot to extract meteo data from

id

Character: name of the column in plot that identifies different points

daterange

Character vector of length 2: starting and ending date from which to extract climate data. Must be in the form yyyy-mm-dd. Default to the whole period of the E-OBS version.

convert_rad

Logical: Should the solar radiation be converted from W m-2 (E-OBS unit) to MJ m-2 day-1 (model unit)? Default to TRUE.

parallel

Logical: Should the extraction be performed in parallel? Default to FALSE

site

Character: the name of the plot site. Used to construct the output name

outdir

Character: path to the output directory.

return_df

Logical: should the climate data be returned by the function as a data.frame? Default to FALSE

version

Character: version of E-OBS, "30.0" or "29.0". Default to "30.0"

eobs_dir

Character: directory with the E-OBS netCDF files (ensemble mean, 0.1 deg, e.g. tg_ens_mean_0.1deg_reg_v30.0e.nc) of the variables hu, qq, rr, tg, tn and tx. Default to the option R3DFEM.eobs_dir or, if not set, to the extdata directory of the installed package.

Value

Used for its side effects. It saves in outdir a file site_meteo.txt The output file have the colums:

  • Year: Reference year for the meteo data

  • Month: number of month in the year

  • n_day: number of day in the month

  • Rg_f: Solar radiation on the ground (in MJ m-2 day-1)

  • Ta_f: Mean temperature (in °C)

  • Tmax: Maximum temperature (in °C)

  • Tmin: Minimum temperature (in °C)

  • RH_f: relative humidity (in %)

  • Ts_f: Daily soil temperature (in °C)

  • Precip: Daily precipitation (in mm day-1)

  • SWC:Soil Water Content (in mm m-2)*

  • LAI:Leaf Area Index (in m2 m-2) *

  • ET: Evapotranspiration (in mm m-2 day-1*

  • WS_f: Wind speed (in m s-1)*

Details

The E-OBS files are not distributed with the package: download them from the Copernicus web site and set, e.g., options(R3DFEM.eobs_dir = "D:/EOBS"). If parallel=TRUE, the user can set a future plan, otherwise the function will use a 7-workers future::plan("multisession") with foreach and the doFuture package. With id, one file per point is written, named id_meteo.txt (site_id_meteo.txt if site is given), as in make_soil_ISRIC. For more information on meteo file needed by the model please refer to the User's Guide
